text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ ۖ كُلٌّۭ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

words.gloss_range: rhetorical negation in the opening seeing formula
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) In the a-lam opening, the particle keeps the shape of negation while reversing it into demanded recognition; after the no-light ending of 24:40, the address now tells the reader that seeing is required.

topics.headline: rhetorical recognition challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as demanded recognition, not a request for new information or a simple denial.
topics.reason: The a-lam construction combines negative form with interrogative reversal, and local attachment keeps negation scoped to the seeing verb.

topics.headline: boundary turns darkness into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the previous no-light scene gives way to an address that requires seeing.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete discourse payoff: a third-person deprivation scene turns into second-person recognition.

words.gloss_range: summoned perception: physical seeing sharpened into judgment
words.root_gloss_range: root range of seeing, perceiving, opinion, and vision; here the seeing formula selects public recognition rather than private vision
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَ}} ({{tr:tara}}) The shortened jussive form makes the summons to perceive feel abrupt, and the root range turns seeing into public judgment of ordered cosmic evidence. After sight nearly fails in 24:40, this seeing formula answers darkness with required recognition.

topics.headline: jussive seeing form under lam
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surface shortening as part of the abrupt rhetorical summons.
topics.reason: QAC and the rows agree that the verb is apocopated by the preceding particle; this is form-specific, not a translation flourish.

topics.headline: seeing becomes public judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats seeing as recognition of ordered signs, not just optical looking.
topics.reason: The root range includes perception and judgment, and the verb governs the whole perceived content clause.

topics.headline: cosmic seeing formula after failed sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah answer the prior darkness scene by summoning perception of cosmic order.
topics.reason: Same-surah and boundary rows make the perception formula part of a movement from defeated sight to required recognition.

words.gloss_range: embedded fact-clause under the perception verb
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) The particle packages God, glorification, the cosmic agents, and the bird formation as one perceived fact, not a detached report. Its embedded scope then gives way to the independent divine-knowledge coda.

topics.headline: embedded perceived fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cosmic praise statement as the content of perception rather than a detached report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the particle clause as the complement of the seeing verb, with the divine name as its governed subject.

topics.headline: embedded scope gives way to coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the perceived scene can be followed by an independent divine-knowledge seal.
topics.reason: The row’s scope debate is preserved, but narrowed by attachment evidence that treats the final divine-name clause as separate.

words.gloss_range: accusative divine name as center of the perceived praise scene
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field tied to worship, turning, and disputed awe/bewilderment; here it anchors the praise target rather than opening a generic deity label
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) The accusative divine name stands first inside the embedded fact, centering God before the agents of praise unfold. That name carries worship-directed and awe-bearing pressure while also preparing the later return to God as knower.

topics.headline: accusative divine name centers the perceived clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices God placed first as the grammatical center of the perceived praise fact.
topics.reason: The divine name is governed by the particle and precedes the act, dative, and subject field.

topics.headline: divine-name worship and awe pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the praise target as worship-directed and awe-bearing, while the local grammar keeps the proper name as the active value.
topics.reason: The disputed derivational pressure is meaningful in a universal-glorification clause, but it does not replace the proper-name function.

topics.headline: opening name anticipates closing name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first divine name prepare an ayah-wide frame that returns to God as knower.
topics.reason: The repeated divine name and nearby heaven-language rows support an envelope and consecutive-ayah resonance.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form II glorification directed to God
words.root_gloss_range: motion-through-a-medium and declaration of transcendence; local Form II selects repeated or intensive glorifying, not mere physical motion
words.prose: {{ar:يُسَبِّحُ}} ({{tr:yusabbiḥu}}) The singular fronted verb establishes one ongoing act of praise directed to God before the many agents appear. Its Form II shape turns the motion-root into repeated transcendence declaration, and the same praise thread later returns as each creature’s known tasbih.

topics.headline: fronted singular act directed before agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one ongoing act of praise fixed toward God before the many glorifiers are revealed.
topics.reason: The verb is singular and preposed, takes no direct object, and is followed by a lām complement before the subject.

topics.headline: Form II turns motion into repeated transcendence declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root’s motion image intensified into purposeful repeated glorification.
topics.reason: V4 branch pressure and the Form II row support glorification as the selected branch, with motion retained as image rather than local sense replacement.

topics.headline: ongoing praise returns as possessed tasbīḥ
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks praise from ongoing cosmic act to each creature’s known mode of glorification.
topics.reason: The imperfect form, co-occurrence rows, root echo, and boundary reversal all keep praise as a moving thread through the ayah.

words.gloss_range: swift dative pronoun fixing the praise target
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) The pronoun phrase routes praise to the named God before any glorifying agents are listed, keeping direction ahead of population. Against the deprived human pronoun at 24:40, the same shape now points to God as the recipient of praise.

topics.headline: dative pronoun fixes recipient before subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that praise is grammatically routed to God before the glorifying population appears.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the lām pronoun the complement of the praise verb, and word order places it before the expansive subject.

topics.headline: same pronoun shape reverses value across boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior deprived human pronoun replaced by the pronoun for God as praise recipient.
topics.reason: The boundary row supplies a concrete contrast in referent and value for the same pronominal shape.

words.gloss_range: open relative subject expanding into a universal creature class
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) The delayed relative pronoun opens a universal subject class, broad enough to include nonhuman participants such as the later birds and then to resolve into plural action. After the no-light field of 24:40, it opens a visible field of glorifiers.

topics.headline: delayed open relative becomes universal subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader watches a small relative pronoun open into a universal subject class that later becomes individualized.
topics.reason: The pronoun is subject of the praise verb, delayed after act and target, then resolved by cosmic location and later plural action.

topics.headline: relative pronoun includes nonhuman participants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nonhuman beings are treated as participants in knowable praise, not as excluded scenery.
topics.reason: The rational-pronoun pressure survives because birds are explicitly singled out, but the local claim should be inclusion rather than a blanket grammar rule.

topics.headline: darkness opens into visible glorifying field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior no-light field answered by a visible field of glorifiers.
topics.reason: Boundary rows contrast the preceding deprived condition with the relative subject that opens the cosmic scene.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition defining the glorifying class as cosmic domain-membership
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) The preposition turns an open “whoever” into beings located within the heavens-and-earth envelope, with one governor holding both domains together as the cosmic setting of praise.

topics.headline: single locative frame for heavens and earth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that location defines the glorifying class: beings inside the whole cosmic domain are included.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the heavens and, through coordination, the earth, turning the open relative into a located totality.

words.gloss_range: definite plural heavens in the cosmic merism
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, sky, and rain/source associations; here the definite plural heavens are the upper domain of the praise field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) The plural heavens begin the totality formula under the locative frame as a definite elevated domain, with height and source-from-above pressure still audible. Paired with earth and then birds, the merism becomes visually inspectable rather than abstract.

topics.headline: definite plural heavens as elevated domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper realm as a definite plural domain inside the praise field, with height and source pressure still audible.
topics.reason: Case governance anchors the word under the locative phrase; root and derivative rows color the domain without displacing the local noun.

topics.headline: heavens-earth totality before the bird bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar heavens-earth totality become visually inspectable through the following bird image.
topics.reason: The plural/singular merism and same-surah echoes support total created scope, while the bird row explains why the next image matters.

words.gloss_range: first conjunction binding earth to the same locative frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) The conjunction coordinates earth with the heavens under the same preposition, making earth a second domain rather than a new clause or restatement. It also begins the ayah’s ladder of repeated conjunctions, whose later rungs change function.

topics.headline: earth coordinated under the same fī
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth as a second domain in the same locative praise frame, not as a new clause or restatement.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates earth with heavens under the previous preposition.

topics.headline: first rung of the conjunction ladder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track how identical conjunctions perform different structural jobs across the ayah.
topics.reason: The first conjunction begins the sequence later used for bird focus, devotional pairing, and coda resumption.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth grounding the cosmic merism
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, breadth, and settled expanse; here the singular definite earth is the lower total domain paired with plural heavens
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) The word keeps earth inside the same locative envelope as a definite grounded expanse, the lower broad domain of glorification. Its singular ground-domain balances the plural heights above before the ayah zooms to birds.

topics.headline: earth as definite grounded expanse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the lower broad domain included in glorification before the ayah zooms to birds.
topics.reason: Case and coordination place earth inside the locative envelope; root pressure adds grounded breadth.

topics.headline: singular earth balances plural heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality is structured as plural heights above and one grounded domain below.
topics.reason: Number contrast, same-surah recurrence, and sound texture preserve a concrete merism payoff.

words.gloss_range: conjunction that zooms from totality to the bird sign
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) After the complete heavens-and-earth merism, this connector opens a focused bird image and becomes the hinge for the bird phrase’s case-sensitive parse. It is the second rung in the conjunction ladder, shifting from domain coordination to concrete specification.

topics.headline: connector zooms from totality to birds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a deliberate shift from cosmic inventory to a focused visible bird sign.
topics.reason: The conjunction follows a complete merism, precedes a nominative bird phrase, and hosts the case-sensitive qirāʾāt hinge.

topics.headline: second conjunction in the ayah ladder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the repeated connector moving from domain coordination to concrete specification.
topics.reason: The four-conjunction row gives structural provenance for the particle’s role in the ayah-wide ladder.

words.gloss_range: nominative collective birds as visible mid-realm sign
words.root_gloss_range: flight, birds, omen/fate associations; here ordered visible flight is selected, while omen/fate associations are only background pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطَّيْرُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭayru}}) The collective noun makes birds one visible class, and the nominative form lets them stand out after the broad cosmic inventory rather than remain another genitive location. The flight and sign field survives as ordered visible motion, while omen or fate associations stay secondary.

topics.headline: nominative collective birds stand out
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees birds as a visible class singled out after the totality formula, not merely another genitive location.
topics.reason: QAC gives nominative collective form, and attachment coordinates birds as another subject while rows preserve the focus break.

topics.headline: flight sign field without omen overread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees birds as ordered moving signs; omen and fate associations remain background, not the local sense.
topics.reason: The root field includes omen/fate derivatives, but the following formation participle and bird-sign parallels select visible ordered flight.

words.gloss_range: outspread bird formation as circumstantial visible order
words.root_gloss_range: row, rank, wing-spread, and ordered array; here the bird posture fuses individual wing extension with collective alignment
words.prose: {{ar:صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:ṣāffātin}}) The participle shows the birds in an ongoing outspread state, so posture becomes part of the praise evidence. Its row and wing-spread field makes the image one of ordered alignment, resonating with worship rows while remaining a concrete flight scene.

topics.headline: birds shown in outspread state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the birds while they are outspread, so posture becomes part of the praise evidence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the participle as circumstantial for the birds; variant rows show the predicate alternative without overriding the standard.

topics.headline: row and wing-spread image carries worship order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bird posture as ordered alignment, resonating with rows of worship while remaining a concrete flight image.
topics.reason: Root, occurrence, sound, and boundary rows converge on alignment: wings or ranks outspread after the prior enclosed darkness.

words.gloss_range: distributive each pivoting from cosmic inventory to individual knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: totality, all-around inclusion, and secondary fatigue/encircling associations; here the selected value is exhaustive eachness
words.prose: {{ar:كُلٌّ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) The singular subject restarts the ayah at the level of each creature, so universal praise becomes each one’s own known devotion rather than an anonymous mass. Its totality pressure also bridges creaturely knowledge to the later divine knowledge coda.

topics.headline: each one restarts the scene individually
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees universal praise become each creature’s own known devotion.
topics.reason: The nominative singular subject with tanwīn starts a new clause and governs singular completed knowing before plural action returns.

topics.headline: totality bridges creaturely and divine knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices totality not as abstraction but as an all-around bridge from creaturely knowledge to divine knowledge.
topics.reason: Root and same-surah rows keep exhaustive pressure, while the echo row connects the creature knowledge clause to the divine coda.

words.gloss_range: certification particle marking accomplished creaturely knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) The particle certifies the perfect verb: each creature’s knowledge is already established, not possible, tentative, or still being acquired, and that completed force belongs to the knowledge claim as a whole.

topics.headline: qad certifies accomplished knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the knowledge claim as already realized for each creature, not as possibility or process.
topics.reason: The particle stands before a perfect verb, so its local force is certification of completed knowledge and it scopes over that verb.

words.gloss_range: completed creaturely knowing of devotional modes
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, signs, teaching, and knowable worlds; here the Form I perfect selects possessed knowledge, not instruction or acquisition
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِمَ}} ({{tr:ʿalima}}) The standard active perfect makes each creature the knower of its own prayer and glorification, while the passive variant would make the devotional modes the known subjects. The knowledge root also keeps cognition tied to signs and a knowable world, though local grammar selects possessed knowing.

topics.headline: each creature actively knows its devotional modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees every creature possessing completed knowledge of its own prayer and glorification.
topics.reason: The standard active perfect takes the distributive subject and governs two devotional objects, then echoes the divine knowledge adjective later.

topics.headline: knowledge root links cognition and signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge in a sign-rich world, while local grammar keeps possessed knowing as the selected sense.
topics.reason: V4 and co-occurrence rows support knowledge/sign pressure; teaching or world senses color the field but do not replace the local verb.

topics.headline: passive reading redistributes agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard reading gives creatures active knowledge, while the passive variant would make the devotional modes the known subjects.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is useful as contrast, but the standard local parse remains active with the creature as knower.

words.gloss_range: possessed prayer as each creature’s known devotional mode
words.root_gloss_range: prayer, supplication, connection, and disputed heat/closeness pressure; here it selects creature-specific directed devotion
words.prose: {{ar:صَلَاتَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ṣalātahū}}) The possessed verbal noun makes prayer an individualized object of knowledge for each creature, not a generic ritual label. Its connection and closeness pressure makes that prayer a directed creature-specific link, paired with glorification as a second devotional vector.

topics.headline: each creature’s own prayer as known object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices prayer as an individualized possessed mode known by each creature.
topics.reason: The verbal noun is accusative object of the knowledge verb with a suffix referring back to the distributive each; passive variant contrast is retained as apparatus.

topics.headline: prayer as directed connection with closeness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears prayer as a directed creature-specific link, while disputed heat or fire imagery remains secondary pressure.
topics.reason: The root field supports connection and fervor, but local syntax selects the known devotional noun.

topics.headline: prayer paired with glorification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees creaturely devotion as a pair: directed relation and declaration of transcendence.
topics.reason: Same-surah, sequence, and matching suffix rows keep prayer and glorification parallel but distinct.

words.gloss_range: object-coordinating conjunction pairing prayer and glorification
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) The conjunction keeps prayer and glorification as two coordinated known modes rather than letting the second merely restate the first. Its local job is object-pairing, not another domain-building or coda-opening conjunction.

topics.headline: conjunction pairs prayer and glorification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two known devotional modes instead of one noun explaining the other.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two accusative possessed verbal nouns under the same knowledge verb.

words.gloss_range: possessed tasbīḥ as the named form of each creature’s praise
words.root_gloss_range: motion and declaration of transcendence; here the Form II verbal noun selects patterned, repeated glorification
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْبِيحَهُۥ}} ({{tr:tasbīḥahū}}) The noun brings the opening praise verb back as each creature’s owned and known glorification, parallel to its prayer. Its Form II verbal-noun pattern makes that tasbih purposeful repeated declaration, so the praise thread returns as a named possessed mode.

topics.headline: tasbīḥ as second owned known mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees glorification as each creature’s own known mode, coequal with prayer.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun a second accusative object coordinated with prayer and marked by the same suffix.

topics.headline: Form II verbal noun names patterned praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears tasbīḥ as purposeful repeated declaration rather than a vague devotional feeling.
topics.reason: Root and pattern rows identify the Form II verbal noun as repeated declaration of transcendence.

topics.headline: opening praise returns as possessed noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same praise root from cosmic activity to each creature’s known possession.
topics.reason: Root echo, co-occurrence, passive-variant, sound, and boundary rows preserve the return of the praise thread.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the divine-knowledge coda
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) The final conjunction resets the discourse from what each creature knows to what God knows, opening the independent divine-knowledge seal. It also closes the conjunction ladder: domains, bird focus, devotional pair, then coda.

topics.headline: final conjunction opens divine-knowledge seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse reset from what each creature knows to what God knows.
topics.reason: The following nominative divine name and nominal clause make the conjunction resumptive while still closing the ayah’s conjunction ladder.

words.gloss_range: nominative divine name as subject of the closing coda
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field tied to worship and awe; here the name anchors the knowing subject of the coda
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) The repeated full name, now nominative, changes God’s syntactic role from perceived center to the knower who seals the ayah. By returning to the name rather than a pronoun, the coda encloses the praise scene inside divine naming and knowledge.

topics.headline: full divine name as coda subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the full name return as nominative subject of a stable knowledge clause.
topics.reason: The coda could have used pronominal reference, but the full nominative name gives the attribute seal explicit weight and contrasts with the earlier accusative.

topics.headline: divine name frames praise and knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah enclosed by the same divine name, with praise inside and divine knowledge at the seal.
topics.reason: Root, formula, envelope, and sound rows support a frame from the perceived praise target to the knowing subject.

words.gloss_range: intensive divine knowledge scoped to creaturely action
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge and sign-field; here the faʿīl adjective selects enduring intensive knowing rather than a momentary act of knowing
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) The adjective makes divine knowledge a stable intensive attribute, surpassing the completed creaturely knowing earlier in the ayah. The following prepositional phrase keeps that attribute from floating abstractly by turning it toward what creatures do.

topics.headline: enduring divine knowledge surpasses creaturely knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes completed creaturely knowing from God’s inherent intensive knowledge.
topics.reason: The predicate adjective in a verbless clause and faʿīl pattern present knowledge as a stable divine attribute, not another completed action.

topics.headline: divine attribute turns toward what creatures do
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is not left abstract; it lands on creaturely action.
topics.reason: The following prepositional phrase scopes the attribute to action, while same-surah formula rows explain the adapted knowledge seal.

words.gloss_range: compact preposition attaching divine knowledge to action-domain
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) The one-letter preposition carries the coda from an attribute to its domain, making divine knowledge syntactically complete as knowledge of what is done. Its specifying force is primary, while the instrumental shade lets deeds disclose the field under divine knowledge.

topics.headline: preposition completes the knowledge domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a small preposition make the divine attribute syntactically and semantically complete.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the complement of the knowledge adjective and the bridge into the relative clause.

topics.headline: specifying and instrumental pressure remain live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears actions as the specified field of divine knowledge, with an instrumental shade that treats deeds as disclosure.
topics.reason: The specifying complement is locally primary; instrumental pressure survives as semantic coloring, not as a replacement for object-domain scope.

words.gloss_range: relative object opening the final action-domain
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) The pronoun makes the final verb the content of divine knowledge, covering both discrete actions and the very event of doing. As the ayah’s closing action-domain, it moves from human seeing to divine knowing of enacted behavior.

topics.headline: relative pronoun supplies what is known
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb subordinated as the content of divine knowledge, covering both actions and doing itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the word as the governed relative content, and the maṣdarī possibility broadens without overturning the relative reading.

topics.headline: the ayah lands on action under divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from human seeing to divine knowing closing on enacted behavior.
topics.reason: The final phrase forms the ayah’s landing point, tying perception, praise, and knowledge to action.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural doing under divine knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: broad active doing and the grammatical root-field of action; here Form I imperfect selects active ongoing deeds rather than passive affectedness or reciprocal interaction
words.prose: {{ar:يَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:yafʿalūna}}) The final verb gathers the distributed glorifiers into ongoing plural action, so their knowledge is completed while their doing continues under divine knowledge. The standard third-person coda reports what they do, while the second-person variant would turn the landing point toward what you do.

topics.headline: plural ongoing action gathers the glorifiers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees creaturely knowledge as completed while their doing continues under divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural refers back to the distributed glorifying beings; Form I keeps the action broad and active.

topics.headline: variant coda can address the audience directly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard coda reports what they do, while the variant would turn the landing point toward what you do.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is preserved as contrast; it should not replace the standard third-person local parse.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه سمو الشيء وعلوه، وارتفاع البصر، وعلو الحسيب والشريف، ورفعة الذكر.
branches.scope_en: Physical or figurative rising, including elevated sight, noble status, and raised mention.

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه سمو الشيء وعلوه، وارتفاع البصر، وعلو الحسيب والشريف، ورفعة الذكر.
variants.scope_en: Physical or figurative rising, including elevated sight, noble status, and raised mention.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الشيء أو الشخص الذي يرتفع فيلوح من بعيد، وسماوة الهلال أو كل شيء بمعنى شخصه العالي الظاهر.
branches.scope_en: A raised person, object, or crescent outline that becomes visible from afar.

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الشيء أو الشخص الذي يرتفع فيلوح من بعيد، وسماوة الهلال أو كل شيء بمعنى شخصه العالي الظاهر.
variants.scope_en: A raised person, object, or crescent outline that becomes visible from afar.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه سما الفحل إذا تطاول أو سطا على شوله، أي علاها وتخللها.
branches.scope_en: A stallion rising or pressing over its she-camels.

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه سما الفحل إذا تطاول أو سطا على شوله، أي علاها وتخللها.
variants.scope_en: A stallion rising or pressing over its she-camels.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه السماء لما علا وأظل، والسقف، والسحاب، والمطر، والنبات المنسوب إلى المطر، وظهر الفرس أو أعلى الشيء.
branches.scope_en: The sky or any upper covering/surface, with source-attested extensions to cloud, rain, vegetation from rain, and an animal's upper back.

variants.scope_ar: يدخل فيه السماء لما علا وأظل، والسقف، والسحاب، والمطر، والنبات المنسوب إلى المطر، وظهر الفرس أو أعلى الشيء.

baseline_models.mechanism: Distributive totality, creaturely knowing, and the paired prayer-glorification terms make universality differentiated: every participant has an appropriate rite, while divine knowledge encloses all of them.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality gathers every participant while كُلٌّ distributes the claim one by one.
Disclosure to a knower grounds both each creature's knowing and God's comprehensive knowledge.
Specified worship supplies the image of each creature's own practiced rite.
The parallel mapped inventory reinforces prayer as a binding, regular act rather than an undifferentiated mood.
Worship through praise and prayer links the creature-specific rite to universal glorification.
The closing reference to enacted work keeps the liturgy performative rather than merely attributed.

changed_reading.before: All creation offers a single generic praise.
changed_reading.after: Universal praise consists of distinct, knowingly enacted creature-specific prayers held together under God's knowledge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The swimming-running image within glorification, the bird's aerial lightness, its line formation, and the closing verb of action allow body, trajectory, and formation to function as the medium of praise.

activation_trace.role: Aerial lightness and flight provide the concrete moving body of the model.
Alignment on a level line makes the birds' bodily ordering part of what is perceived.
Swimming, running, and traversing air supply motion as the functional image of glorification.
Enacted work licenses reading the visible flight-pattern as performance, not scenery.

changed_reading.before: The birds praise while incidentally flying in formation.
changed_reading.after: Their flight and alignment can themselves be the embodied performance of praise.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening demand to see, followed by a visible formation and a knowledge-root that also images a distinguishing mark, makes observable order a clue by which hidden praise is recognized.

activation_trace.role: Eye-sight and insight jointly frame the ayah as an act of recognition.
Rhetorical alert turns the opening question into a demand to reconsider what the visible scene signifies.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies the secondary image of creaturely order as a legible marker.
The birds' line is the ayah's especially inspectable mark.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports an otherwise hidden cosmic hymn.
changed_reading.after: It also asks the reader to infer that hymn from visible, distinguishing patterns of creaturely order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first separates tongue-carried assertion from knowledge, then makes tongues and limbs testify to deeds. Against that sequence, the focus's coupling of each creature's knowledge, prayer, action, and God's knowledge reads as truthful embodied witness rather than ungrounded utterance.

activation_trace.role: Saying what was not securely known supplies the contrast of assertion detached from truth.
Knowledge is explicitly absent from the tongue-borne claim, exposing the epistemic break.
The tongue as witness relocates truthful disclosure from rumor to embodied testimony.
Intended action is what the body's testimony discloses.
Creaturely and divine knowing close the gap that characterized irresponsible human speech.
Enacted conduct makes the creature's glorification evidence-bearing.

structural_cues: 24:15 places tongue-transmission, speech, and lack of knowledge in one construction.
24:24 makes bodily members testify specifically to what people worked.
24:41 binds knowing, prayer, glorification, and doing before repeating divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech without knowledge, bodily testimony to deeds, and the focus's knowing-doing pair; I infer a contrast in which creaturely praise is truth-bearing embodied evidence. Literal vocal praise remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic praise is imagined chiefly as an anthropomorphic utterance.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic praise is a knowing performance whose ordered action truthfully testifies, unlike speech severed from knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light discourse and the immediately preceding failure to see one's own hand make the focus's opening question epistemic rather than casually optical; the later call to take a lesson with insight confirms that visible phenomena require right illumination and interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the condition under which a sign can disclose rather than merely appear.
Failed eye-sight immediately before the focus destabilizes any assumption that seeing is automatic.
The absence of God-given light explains the failure of recognition.
The renewed appeal to sight and insight asks the reader to cross from obscurity into recognition.
Making one condition a lesson for another names the interpretive transfer required by the visible scene.
Insight of the heart confirms that the target faculty exceeds bare eyesight.

structural_cues: 24:35 presents divine light as layered disclosure.
24:40 ends with inability to see and lack of light immediately before أَلَمْ تَرَ in 24:41.
24:44 calls the adjacent natural sequence a lesson for possessors of insight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies light, failed sight, a renewed seeing-question, and an explicit lesson for insight; I infer that recognition of cosmic praise is light-enabled interpretation. Ordinary optical observation remains part of the prompt, especially through the visible birds.

changed_reading.before: Have you not seen is a routine appeal to an obvious natural fact.
changed_reading.after: It is a demand for illuminated discernment: the aligned birds make worship legible, but unilluminated sight can still miss what they show.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, people glorify God in permitted houses, resist distraction, remember God, establish prayer, and are repaid for action; later, named prayers mark daily times. Repetition of the focus's own prayer-glorification pair makes human ritual one specified member of a wider plurality of creaturely rites.

activation_trace.role: Human worship through glorification supplies the nearest concrete instance of the focus's universal predicate.
Refusal to be diverted makes the human rite a sustained orientation rather than a passing utterance.
Maintained recollection supplies the cognitive continuity of the human practice.
Established specified worship gives a concrete human form to prayer.
The second mapped inventory reinforces prayer as an obligatory, structured rite.
Reward for intended action joins liturgy to the focus's closing language of doing.
Named prayers at distinct daily boundaries sharpen the idea that a rite has its own time and mode.
The same worship-praise root extends the nearby human scene to every being in the heavens and earth.
Each creature's possessive prayer preserves specificity inside that extension.

structural_cues: 24:36-37 uses يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ and الصلاة directly before the focus repeats both terms.
24:38 closes the human worship scene with recompense for what they did.
24:58 distinguishes prayers by daily boundary, supporting mode- and time-specific ritual.
24:41 shifts from particular human worshippers to distributive كُلٌّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical liturgical vocabulary, human discipline, and differentiated prayer times; I infer an analogical continuum in which human worship is one creaturely mode, not that birds and humans perform the same rite. Mere lexical homonymy remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Human ritual and nonhuman praise are separate categories placed near one another.
changed_reading.after: Human remembrance and prayer become one species-specific instance within the ayah's differentiated cosmic liturgy.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the aligned birds, clouds are gently driven, joined, and stacked, while water-born creatures move by sharply different gaits. Those operations activate the swimming-running branch of glorification and make each creature's proper, designed kinematics a plausible form of its own prayer.

activation_trace.role: Swimming, running, and aerial traversal provide the focus anchor for praise as kinematics.
Flight gives the model its first species-specific mode of motion.
Line formation shows that the motion has ordered configuration.
Gentle driving supplies directed motion rather than random displacement.
Joining one thing to another supplies coordinated formation.
Accumulation one part over another gives the cloud a productive ordered structure.
Measured determination links differing bodily forms to designed capacities.
A shared material origin sharpens, by contrast, the diversity of creaturely modes.
Repeated walking and movement distribute action across belly, two-legged, and four-legged gaits.

structural_cues: 24:41 singles out aerial movement in line formation.
24:43 sequences driving, joining, stacking, and issuing rain.
24:45 repeats يَمْشِي across three bodily configurations while retaining a common watery origin.
The focus's كُلٌّ and possessive صلاته preserve distinct modes within universality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered motions, designed forms, and the motion branch of س ب ح; I infer that faithful enactment of a creature's proper movement can count as its glorification. The adjacent natural processes may instead be examples of power without defining praise.

changed_reading.before: All creatures praise in essentially the same unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: Each creature can praise by enacting the distinct motion, formation, and capacity measured into its form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate declaration of divine sovereignty and return, together with the surah's closing knowledge, return, disclosure, and deeds, turns the focus's final omniscience clause into jurisdiction and accounting. Cosmic glorification thereby acknowledges an order of ownership to which action returns.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty over the same heavens and earth gives the focus's universal scene a jurisdictional frame.
Movement toward the final outcome makes creaturely action return rather than dissipate.
Comprehensive knowledge at the surah's close repeats the focus's enclosure of all action.
A delivered report turns known deeds into disclosed account.
Intended work is the content of that final disclosure.
Universal worship becomes the enacted acknowledgment situated inside sovereignty.
The focus's deeds-language is the exact hinge from liturgy toward accountability.

structural_cues: 24:42 immediately restates the heavens and earth as divine sovereignty and names the return.
24:64 closes the surah by joining divine knowledge, return, reporting, and what people did.
24:41 itself moves from universal glorification to God's knowledge of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereignty, return, reporting, and deeds around the focus's knowledge clause; I infer a forensic dimension in which praise acknowledges jurisdiction and action is accountable. The closing clause can still function as a non-forensic statement of omniscience.

changed_reading.before: God knows what they do merely reassures that every hidden praise is observed.
changed_reading.after: The clause also places every performance within divine sovereignty, return, disclosure, and accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats spatial relation as liturgical rather than scenic. It remains anchored in صَافَّاتٍ and gains mechanism from the adjacent contrast between opaque layering and productive joining-stacking; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy, not as a lexical definition of tasbih.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on a level line makes inter-body relation explicit in the focus.
Repeated vertical superposition produces an opaque, disorienting arrangement and shows that geometry can bear consequence.
Joining parts supplies a constructive relational operation.
Productive stacking supplies an ordered geometry from which rain emerges.

changed_reading.before: The bird formation is a decorative detail accompanying praise.
changed_reading.after: The line itself may participate in praise: right relation and arrangement among bodies can function liturgically.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the racing image of the one who follows the leader within both mapped prayer inventories. It remains anchored in صَلَاتَهُ, the birds' line, and the surah's competing tracks of following and obedience; downstream prose must qualify it as a secondary word-image, never replace the ordinary sense of prayer with it.

activation_trace.role: The runner who follows the leader supplies prayer as ordered succession behind a precedent.
The parallel mapped branch preserves the same following image across the split inventory.
The birds' line gives ordered following a visible focus anchor.
Following and trailing supply the surah's negative counter-course.
Tracks and steps followed by a traveler make course-selection concrete.
Compliance supplies the positive alternative of entering the right course.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is only address or ritual directed upward.
changed_reading.after: Prayer may also carry a secondary image of entering the proper sequence behind a divinely set lead, a course creatures know while humans can follow wrongly.

strongest_changes: The light-darkness sequence turns أَلَمْ تَرَ into illuminated discernment rather than casual eyesight.
Human glorification and prayer in 24:36-38 become one specified instance of differentiated cosmic liturgy.
Cloud formation and diverse animal gaits strengthen praise as ordered creaturely action.
Speech without knowledge and bodily testimony recast praise as knowing, truth-bearing performance.
The sovereignty and closing-account frame gives God's knowledge of deeds an accountable dimension.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context activated a coherent link among visibility, knowledge, embodied order, and accountable action while preserving distinct liturgical, kinematic, epistemic, and forensic readings.
remaining_uncertainties: How literally creaturely knowledge in عَلِمَ should be rendered remains open.
Whether tasbih is audible, behavioral, or both is unresolved.
The geometry and following models depend on non-primary branch images and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Each creature's prayer is an informed mode of ordered action.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `س ب ح` B001 is worship/praise and B004 coursing motion; `ط ي ر` B001 is airborne movement; `ص ف ف` B001 is arrangement in a straight row; `ص ل و` B003 is prescribed worship and B006 following a leader in second place; `ع ل م` B001 is knowing; `ف ع ل` B001 is bringing an act about. **Structural cue:** 24:36 uses the same praise-root for recurrent house practice, 24:40 shows disordered layered perception, and 24:43-45 show clouds, day/night, and creatures moving in differentiated courses. **Assigned role:** birds make alignment visible, coursing makes praise kinetic, and knowledge assigns each actor its own prayer/action pattern. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies row, movement, known practice, and deed; I infer that praise is realized as species-appropriate ordered performance, not necessarily one uniform human-like utterance. **Reading change:** cosmic worship becomes coordinated plurality: every creature knows and enacts its mode within a larger order.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:43-45 made species-specific prayer more than a bird image: cloud aggregation, day/night turning, and distinct creature gaits showed several enacted orders. 24:46 named their human analogue as directed path.

baseline.text: Göklerde ve yerde bulunanların ve kanatlarını açmış kuşların Allah'ı yücelttiğini görmedin mi? Her biri kendi duasını ve yüceltmesini bilir. Allah onların yaptıklarını bilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
